fingerprint.structure: 1 slide: a single selfie with a crowdsourcing question as the whole post. No hook-then-payoff sequence; the payoff is in the comments (the replies she is asking for).
fingerprint.hook: Direct-address advice request, on screen from the start: `I'm incredibly broke, please give me your most unhinged money making hacks. I'm not talking [safe, boring example] - i wanna hear something crazy but you don't regret it.` A confession + a request for extreme answers + a pre-emptive rule-out of the boring answer + a safety caveat.
fingerprint.camera_motion: humans. Selfie (term 1: front camera, close, no phone in shot), tight face crop from the nose up, brows raised, wide unblinking eyes, exaggerated distress. Plain grey-brown wall behind, low clutter.
fingerprint.pacing: 1 slide, about 40 words in the text block: dense but a single read is enough because it is a question, not a story.
fingerprint.text_overlay: TikTok native text, white with a thick black outline (Classic), sentence case, centred, 6 lines, sits in the middle of the frame over her forehead and eyes area (the crop is tight enough that the text overlaps the top of her head slightly).
fingerprint.audio: a dramatic classical orchestral piece ('Dance of the Knights', Prokofiev; not an original sound), used for comic irony against the deadpan/distressed face, not for lyrics.
fingerprint.arc: Comic distress bait: the exaggerated crying-adjacent face plus a self-aware, escalating request is the whole joke; the format exists to farm wild replies in the comments.
